Each entry is the cross section in nb integrated over the corresponding four-dimensional bin; the bin volume is given in the last column of the table. The bin-averaged density (the cross section divided by the bin volume) is a derived quantity that is deliberately not tabulated, and model predictions must be integrated over the same bin volume before comparison with the tabulated values. The values are Born-level cross sections: they are corrected for detector effects and for radiative (QED and electroweak) effects; the correction convention is photon exchange only, i.e. the cross sections are defined without $Z$-boson exchange. Each cross section is quoted with its statistical uncertainty and its total systematic uncertainty. Two correction factors are tabulated for reference: the factor applied in this table (seventh column), which follows the photon-exchange-only convention, and the corresponding factor of the convention with $Z$-boson exchange included (sixth column); the ratio of the two factors converts a cross section between the two conventions. }
